svg.text: An RR interval is the time from one R peak (the tall spike of ventricular depolarisation) to the next; heart-rate variability is built only from these intervals. Here record 119 slips
from normal rhythm into ventricular bigeminy: every second beat is a premature ventricular contraction (red V, wide and inverted), so the intervals alternate short (N→V, the
coupling interval) and long (V→N, the compensatory pause). Hover the trace for exact samples (360 Hz, 200 ADC units per mV); click a beat for the record's clinical notes.
